title: Projection formula for a constant twist
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, using the Weil categories of [def-wf-weil-category]. Let
$h:X_0\to Y_0$ be a
separated finite-type
morphism of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, let
$\mathcal K$ be a constructible $\Qlb$-Weil complex on $X_0$, and
let $b\in\Qlb^\times$ and let $\mathcal B_b$ be the
constant Weil twist of [def-wf-constant-weil-twist] on $Y_0$.
There is a Frobenius-compatible isomorphism

$$
Rh_!\bigl(\mathcal K\otimes h^*\mathcal B_b\bigr)
\;\cong\;Rh_!\mathcal K\otimes\mathcal B_b.
$$

proof.text: Write $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and $f=h\times_{k_0}k$ for the geometric morphism. The coefficient object $\mathcal B_b$ of [def-wf-constant-weil-twist] is a rank-one Weil sheaf, regarded in degree zero, so its underlying complex is bounded constructible. At $\Qlb$ coefficients [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] defines $D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Qlb)=D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)$. Thus $L=\mathcal B_b$ meets the finite-Tor input condition of the projection formula, while $K=\mathcal K$ meets its bounded constructible input condition by hypothesis. No integrality or absolute-value condition on the nonzero scalar $b$ is required.

source.place: Proof, application to the constant rank-one twist: input-domain check

proof.text: Apply [fix-prop-projection-formula] to the separated finite-type finite-field model $h:X_0\to Y_0$, its geometric morphism $f$, and the inputs $K=\mathcal K$, $L=\mathcal B_b$ checked in step 1. Its algebraically closed coefficient clause gives $u:Rh_!\mathcal K\otimes^L\mathcal B_b\xrightarrow{\sim}Rh_!(\mathcal K\otimes^L h^*\mathcal B_b)$ in the Weil category itself. The theorem explicitly restricts to that category for geometric base changes of separated finite-type $k_0$-morphisms between separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, precisely the hypotheses here; in particular $u$ is Frobenius-compatible. The tensor and pullback in this formula are the derived operations denoted by $\otimes$ and $h^*$ in the item.

source.place: Proof, projection formula for compact-support direct image and its Weil restriction

proof.text: Set $S=Rh_!\mathcal K\otimes\mathcal B_b$ and $T=Rh_!(\mathcal K\otimes h^*\mathcal B_b)$. In the notation of [def-wf-weil-category], Frobenius compatibility of $u:S\to T$ reads $u\varphi_S=\varphi_T\Phi_Y^*(u)$. Composing on the left with $u^{-1}$ and on the right with $\Phi_Y^*(u^{-1})$ gives $\varphi_S\Phi_Y^*(u^{-1})=u^{-1}\varphi_T$. Hence $u^{-1}:T\to S$ is a Weil morphism, with inverse $u$, and is the required Frobenius-compatible isomorphism in the direction displayed in the statement. The same equations hold for common-stage morphism classes in the $\Qlb$ category by its definition.
